articles.summary: Introducing @rent-the-runway/rtr-react-okta-auth , an open source NPM library to facilitate Okta integration for ReactJS applications. It’s a layer of abstraction built on top of @okta/okta-react .
articles.title: Don't React Now: You're Not Authorized; Taking Stock of Okta Auth

articles.summary: I urge developers to stop being annoyed by their flaky end-to-end tests and test frameworks, and appreciate flakiness as feedback about application design that leads to flaky behavior.
articles.title: Leveraging Flaky Tests to Identify Race Conditions Using Cypress
